name: openai-to-anthropic-transformer
description: Translates OpenAI Chat Completions requests into Anthropic Messages API format and rewrites non-streaming and streaming Anthropic responses back into OpenAI-compatible JSON or Chat Completions Server-Sent Events. Supports system prompts, multi-modal image input, tool/function calling, and both routed (multi-provider) and unconditional (single-provider) execution modes.
